source.citation: Sutton, J.; Tseng, T.-L.B. Effect of Electromagnetic Damping on System Performance of Voice-Coil Actuator Applied to Balancing-Type Scale. Actuators 2020, 9, 8.
source.data_origin: Published paper Table 2 (parameters), Figures 12 and 13 (step responses; not yet digitized).

substrate_class_variant: bare cantilever beam + bobbin + permanent magnet, no cone/cavity

shared_parameters.parameter_provenance: Paper Table 2; values verified against File B research output 2026-05-12.

aluminum_bobbin.tuning_axis: eddy-current damping from conductive bobbin material
aluminum_bobbin.regime_notes: Deeply overdamped. Eddy currents in the aluminum bobbin dominate dissipation. The two-real-exponentials regime (no oscillation). chit at steady state operation is well-defined but no resonance peak to read at.

plastic_bobbin.tuning_axis: eddy-current damping from conductive bobbin material
plastic_bobbin.regime_notes: Lightly overdamped, but still below Q = 0.5 (s-boundary). Approaching critical damping but does not reach it. Step response is two-real-exponentials, slower-decaying mode dominates.

source_figures: Figure 12: Step-input deflection response, aluminum bobbin (heavy eddy damping).
Figure 13: Step-input deflection response, plastic bobbin (light damping).
step_response_data.digitization_plan: Use WebPlotDigitizer or equivalent to extract (t, deflection) pairs from each figure. Sample density: enough to fit the decay tail. Pending Phase A step 6 (smoke experiment).

F-001-actuator-mdpi-2020.predicted_bound_lower: Requires electromechanical efficiency eta = useful mechanical work / electrical input. Not directly published; derivable from kf, R, mass, k.

F-003-actuator-mdpi-2020-partial.description: Decay tail shape across two damping levels (Al vs plastic).
F-003-actuator-mdpi-2020-partial.predicted: Both r-regime → both exponential (sum of two real exponentials, slower mode dominating). cdv1 predicts algebraic settling only at Q = 0.5 exactly; both instances are off-attractor.
